The journey through Torres del Paine National Park begins with a boat trip to **Grey Glacier**. From the water, you will approach the ice wall and see it against the mountains of Chilean Patagonia.

After returning to the pier, the route continues through the park's natural attractions. You will see Lake Sofía, the Prat mountain range, Lake Porteño, Cerro Mesa and Lake Toro. Next, visit the viewpoint at **Lake Pehoé** and **Salto Grande Waterfall**, which is 18 metres high.

Further stops include Lake Nordenskjöld, Laguna Amarga and Lake Sarmiento. The programme also includes **Mylodon Cave**. After exploring these natural sites, you will return to your hotel.

**Included in the price:** admission to the national park, the boat trip to Grey Glacier and lunch.
